This is a VP9 fix from 2014, not the AV1 issue we're looking for. Let me search for the specific OSS-Fuzz issue 42533480. This is a use-of-uninitialized-value in the AV1 decoder. Let me look at the git history around the time this issue was reported and search for relevant fixes.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/aom && git log --all --oneline --since="2023-01-01" --until="2024-12-31" --grep="uninit" | head -20 && echo "---" && git log --all --oneline --since="2023-01-01" --until="2024-12-31" --grep="msan" | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
